subject: reasoning
question: DGJH is related to LORP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JMPN is related to RUXV. To which of the following is ILOM related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'DGJH is related to LORP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9f0d5755950272720f653531955a219d167726a5c38d73b75f407be95be442d.png] 

For, 'JMPN is related to RUXV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/835530a09738190960b0d6d3785547327b499edd5600f984778c87009e5575e1.png] 

Similarly, for '**ILOM**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0de663532c59f6df2beaf674af836ed057686db31d1abc055c5e94c8fd58d51f.png] 

So, 'ILOM' will be related to '**QTWU**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
